description: Defines the android::Region class, which manages rectangular regions with operations like union, intersection, subtraction, and translation. Includes methods for region manipulation, comparison, and iteration, and integrates with hashing and printing utilities.

classes.name: Region
classes.description: Represents a rectangular region with various geometric and boolean operations, supporting iteration, flattening, and comparison.

methods.name: createTJunctionFreeRegion
methods.description: Creates a region without T-junctions from an existing region.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the region is empty.

methods.name: isRect
methods.description: Checks if the region consists of a single rectangle.

methods.name: getBounds
methods.description: Returns the bounding rectangle of the region.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Checks if a point or coordinate is within the region.

methods.name: makeBoundsSelf
methods.description: Converts the region to its bounding rectangle.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears the region.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets the region to a specified rectangle or size.

methods.name: orSelf, xorSelf, andSelf, subtractSelf
methods.description: Performs boolean operations with rectangles or regions, modifying the current region.

methods.name: merge, mergeExclusive, intersect, subtract
methods.description: Returns new regions resulting from boolean operations with rectangles or regions.

methods.name: translateSelf, scaleSelf
methods.description: Translates or scales the region.

methods.name: translate, merge, mergeExclusive, intersect, subtract
methods.description: Returns new regions translated or combined with offsets.

methods.name: operator |, ^, &, -, +
methods.description: Operator overloads for region operations.

methods.name: operator |=, ^=, &=, -=, +=
methods.description: Operator overloads for in-place region modifications.

methods.name: isTriviallyEqual
methods.description: Checks if two regions share the same storage.

methods.name: hasSameRects
methods.description: Checks if two regions have the same rectangle sequence.

methods.name: begin, end, getArray
methods.description: Provides access to the internal rectangle list.

methods.name: addRectUnchecked
methods.description: Adds a rectangle to the region without validation.

methods.name: getFlattenedSize, flatten, unflatten
methods.description: Serialization methods for the region.

methods.name: dump
methods.description: Outputs a textual representation of the region.
